why: The counterweight to the two noise templates. A prompt tuned only against weekend dips and small samples learns to call everything noise, which is a worse monitor than one that warns too often — it fails silently. Here the sample is large, the day is an ordinary weekday, the same-weekday baseline rules out seasonality, and a second independent monitor on the same table agrees. Nothing is left but a real fault.

monitor_rows.message: Row count on a Tuesday is 98.7% below the trailing 7-day average. The same-weekday (Tuesday) trailing average is 1,884,006. This table has not been below 1.5M rows on any weekday in 180 days.
Null rate is 61.4% against a 180-day baseline of 0.2%, on the same run.
